title: 109 and 582 Squadrons RAF - Bomber Command
memorial_details: Rough-cut stone of remembrance (granite?) with polished, oval face for the dedicatory inscription, which is in black, upper-case lettering. The stone is flanked by two low wooden planters. The 2021 image reveals that a laurel bush has grown as a backdrop to the memorial. Gold coloured RAF emblem in the upper centre of the stone.
inscription: ROYAL AIR FORCE / LITTLE STAUGHTON / 109 AND 582 SQUADRONS / 8 GROUP / PATH FINDER FORCE / BOMBER COMMAND / 1944 - 1945
